title: erysimum capitatum subsp. angustatum
intro: Erysimum capitatum subsp. angustatum, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Wallflower, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, antioxidant activity, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Narrow-leaved Wallflower include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include isothiocyanates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, and flavonoids, such as kaempferol, quercetin, and isorhapontigenin, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
